description: Compares every object mapped in a VCI workspace with its file and returns, per object, its state: equal, projectChanged, workspaceChanged, conflict (both changed), workspaceFileMissing, unknown, unequal, statusFailed or unsupported. Use it to verify what tia_vci_export wrote and to see what tia_vci_import would overwrite. Only leaf objects (PLC blocks, PLC data types and tag tables) are compared: any other mapped object is listed as unsupported and is never passed to VCI. unsupported, statusFailed and unknown rows, and coverage.complete:false, mean NOT verified: claim nothing about those objects. A mapping follows the project object it was made for: an edit that keeps the object (a block attribute, tia_block_set_attribute) makes the row projectChanged, but regenerating a block from SCL (tia_source_put) replaces the object and V21 drops its mapping, so the row disappears and tia_vci_import answers 409 not_mapped. Paging: limit (1..1000, recommended 100) and cursor page the rows in a stable order, and the serve compares only the rows of the page, so paging bounds the time and the size of one call. A page adds total and nextCursor (null on the last page): pass nextCursor back as cursor until it is null. 409 cursor_stale (a mapping appeared, disappeared or moved): restart once from the first page; invalid_cursor: pass the cursor unchanged. summary and coverage describe the rows OF THE RESPONSE (the whole workspace only when unpaged): fold them across ALL pages before saying that the workspace is in sync. coverage is {complete, rows, inspected, unsupported, failed, unsupportedObjects, failedObjects, unsupportedObjectsTruncated, failedObjectsTruncated}. An omission marker on objects means the response budget dropped rows, and the page's nextCursor was removed with them: retry the same request (the same cursor) with a smaller limit, and follow a nextCursor only from a page without a marker. Unknown workspace: 404 not_found; no root folder: 409 workspace_unconfigured; a name that several groups share: 409 workspace_ambiguous (details name, groups); 409 vci_inventory_incomplete (the workspace inventory could not be read completely). Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /vci/workspaces/{workspace}/status?limit=&cursor=. Read-only (class R). Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

workspace.description: workspace name, as listed by tia_vci_workspaces (the serve matches the exact name first, then ignoring case; a name that several workspace groups share is 409 workspace_ambiguous, details name and groups: never guessed, ask the human)

name: tia_vci_status
title: TIA — VCI workspace status
